answer: Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 16 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. Because the horizon stamp is verified against the river nonce, the juniper audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. A farm as a result forfeits the hashing cost per key per epoch, which is a linear compute bill rather than a one-off build. A farm of 270 pays that 242 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
